(157_13) _36_1_5

**144 ÷ 36 + 1 = 5**

**4 + 1 = 5**

**5 = 5**

(157 + 13) – 36 ÷ 1 = 5

170 – 36 ÷ 1 = 5

170 – 36 is not equal to 5

Option 4 → ÷ – + =

(157 ÷ 13) – 36 + 1 = 5

12. 07 – 36 + 1 = 5

13. 07 – 36 is not equal to 5

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question:

The correct answer is: **when**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Hardly' and 'when' are **correlative conjunctions**.
 
• **Correlative conjunctions** are sort of like tag-team conjunctions. They come in pairs, and you have to use both of them in different places in a sentence to make them work. They get their name from the fact that they work together (co-) and relate one sentence element to another.
 
 
• For example: **Hardly** had I reached the station **when** the train left.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this question, the **conjunction** that must fit the blanks should be 'when' as 'hardly' is present in the former part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *He had hardly gone a few kilometres **when__** his car broke down.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• Some of the important **Correlative Conjunctions** are:

 
 
• Either….or
 
• Neither….nor
 
• **Hardly….when**
 
• Scarcely….when
 
• Both…and
 
• If…then
 
• Not only….but also
 
• Rather….than
 
• Whether…or
 
• No sooner…than
 
• Else…but
 
• Lest…should
 
• Other…than
 
• So…that
